source: Hand-compiled from the sources named on each row; read 9 Oct 2026
note: Egypt's public holidays and the lunar dates that move every year. Fixed-date holidays are firm. Every Islamic date is a forecast from astronomical calculation and is confirmed only by the official moon sighting (Dar al-Ifta) — so each lunar row carries a range, not a day, and is marked expected. No official Egyptian government list for 2027 had been published when this was compiled; the rows below come from named secondary calendars, and where they disagree the range covers both.
